messages:
Nora (CS): Heads-up team — a set of trial tenants reported delayed activations and partial webhook failures this morning. Need an outbound they can personalize, a small credit offer, and prioritized enablement slots. Drafted below.

Raj (Support): How many tenants and what's the failure surface?

Nora (CS): 14 tenants total: mix of SMB and a few mid-market. Failures were webhook callback retries piling up and the final reindex job timing out. Window: 06:45 - 07:28 UTC. No PII exposure.

IncidentBot: INCIDENT-2026-0502 created: onboarding-queue-surge. Severity: P3. Team assigned: eng-runtime.

Elena (CS Manager): Draft outbound (short + personalize for mid-market):

"Hi [Customer name],

Were sorry — we experienced an onboarding delay this morning that slowed tenant activation. Root cause: an autoscaler routing change that briefly directed onboarding bursts to a saturated pool, causing retries and some 504s. We reverted the change and processed queued jobs.

What weve done: rolled back the routing change at 07:28 UTC, provisioned temporary burst capacity, and expedited pending reindex jobs.

How well help: a complimentary 30-minute onboarding tune-up (screen share) and a one-time onboarding credit equal to 12% of measured onboarding usage during the window.

No customer data was exposed. Reply to book a slot or ask for a priority time. Feedback: https://redwood.internal/cs/onboard-incident-feedback

Thanks, Nora (on behalf of Redwood Inference)"

Theo (Solutions Eng): For enterprise notes add a 1-line executive summary and a tech blurb:
- exec line: "Weve fixed the activation delay and escalated monitoring; details below."
- tech blurb: regression in autoscaler route preference -> rollback, added saturation guard and queue-depth alert.

Sam (Sales Ops): Credit process — confirm percent vs prorated model?

Nora (CS): Using a flat 12% simplifies ops for trials. For accounts flagged as renewal-risk, escalate to 18% and loop AMs. Log in SF.

Raj (Support): Suggest we include a tiny "what you can check" snippet for customers before the call:
- ensure webhook endpoint returns 200
- verify custom webhook retry logic isn't duplicating requests
- quick status check: `curl -s https://internal/metrics/onboard?tenant_id=... | jq .queue_depth`

Elena (CS Manager): Good. Also add local-time conversion for high-touch emails so customers see their timezone window.

Theo (Solutions Eng): I'll add the short RCA paragraph for the postmortem that we can attach later: cause = routing preference change without saturation checks; fix = rollback + saturation guard + new queue-depth alert + one-off backlog drain.

Sam (Sales Ops): I'll prepare the credit memos and flag renewal-risk accounts for 18% uplift. ETA 35m.

Nora (CS): Proposed send cadence: mid-market/high-touch at 09:00 UTC (AMs cc'd), SMB at 10:30 UTC. Any objections?

Raj (Support): No objections. I'll send the high-touch batch and ping when complete. Include calendar stub for prioritized slots.

Raj (Support): Sent high-touch batch at 09:03 UTC. CCs to AMs included. :white_check_mark:

Elena (CS Manager): Two replies already requesting immediate onboarding sessions. Scheduling now and marking account timelines.

Nora (CS): Please capture each reply in the account health tracker and update renewal-risk if they escalate. We'll attach eng-runtime's formal RCA when available. Also add a 24h feedback pulse link in follow-up.

Raj (Support): SMB batch queued; sent at 10:31 UTC. Low reply volume so far.

Sam (Sales Ops): Credit memos prepared and queued for approval. I'll update here when processed.

(10:50 UTC) Nora (CS): Closing this thread for coordination. Action items logged:
- Theo: publish tech blurb for the postmortem (ETA: after eng RCA)
- Sam: finalize credits and memos (ETA: 35m)
- Raj: include calendar stubs + capture outbound copies in account timelines
- Elena: track replies and renewal-risk updates in SF

Thanks all — will reopen if we get escalations."
